params.prompt: Cinematic montage of a serene young woman in flowing traditional white and blue robes, living harmoniously with nature. The sequence begins with her kneeling by a clear stream, smiling gently as she holds a small fish in her cupped hands, water droplets glistening on her skin. Transition to a wide shot of her sitting peacefully on a grassy riverbank at golden hour, eyes closed, face tilted toward the warm sunlight, bare feet resting near the water's edge. A close-up follows, capturing her profile bathed in dappled light filtering through bamboo leaves. Next, she is seen laughing joyfully while reaching up into a lush green tree to pick fruit, wearing a deep indigo garment. The scene shifts to her fishing under weeping willows, holding a bamboo rod with a woven basket beside her. Finally, she sits elegantly in a wooden boat amidst a lotus pond, holding a paper umbrella, looking back over her shoulder with a soft expression. High-quality 4k resolution, photorealistic style, dreamy atmosphere, soft focus background, natural lighting, slow motion effects, ethereal and tranquil mood.
